interpretation: 240 counts registered model runs, not independent or necessarily numerically distinct predictors. Matching reruns do not add independent scientific evidence. limitations: State and observed log-score equality is recorded separately; observed outputs on source/C/D do not prove universal functional identity. This review adds no training/inference and performs no deduplication.
